name: RG202617
tagline: Modern multi-fuel efficiency with a classic built-in oven
description: A versatile and robust contemporary stove that blends high-capacity space heating with practical culinary utility. The Victoria Triumph F features a primary combustion chamber lined with heat-accumulating firebricks and a secondary upper oven compartment equipped with a glass-mounted thermometer for precision baking. Its sleek graphite finish and tall, upright design make it a perfect fit for modern homes seeking both warmth and a reliable off-grid cooking solution.
features: Integrated upper oven with a door-mounted thermometer
Primary and secondary air controls for optimized combustion
Heat-resistant ceramic glass windows for both firebox and oven
Large easy-access ash pan for simplified maintenance
